highlights: Actual for Q2FY27: Revenue - MISS; EBITDA Margins - MISS ; PAT - MISS Changes in Estimates post Q2FY27 FY27E/FY28E: Revenue: -2/-4%; EBITDA: -3%/-4%; PAT: -5%/-6% Recommendation Rationale • Biopharmaceuticals Lead Top-Line Growth; Services Segment Recovers Sequentially: Biocon reported revenue from operations of Rs 4,389 Cr in Q2FY27, registering 2% YoY growth.

Revenue growth was primarily driven by the Biopharmaceuticals division, with the Biosimilars business growing 3% YoY to Rs 2,809 Cr, supported by strong traction in North America and new product launches like Yesafili and Yesintek, though tempered by a 5% shipment revenue deferral into Q3.

The Generics segment also delivered healthy growth of 10% YoY to Rs 774 Cr, driven by the scale-up of generic Liraglutide across global markets, including the US, along with improved capacity utilization.

However, overall revenue growth was partially offset by a 9% YoY decline in the Services segment (Syngene) to Rs 833 Cr, despite a 13% QoQ rebound. • Operational Efficiencies Support Margins; Lower Interest Costs Aid Deleveraging: EBITDA for Q2FY27 stood at Rs 865 Cr, down 7% YoY, with the EBITDA margin at 20%.
